policy: Index families are canonical views over shared entities; duplicate views are not competing sources of truth.

indexes.name: Master Entity Index
indexes.scope: All identifiable entities; canonical identity is distinct from source IDs.

indexes.name: System Index
indexes.scope: Systems and subsystems, with explicit boundaries.

indexes.name: Architecture Index
indexes.scope: Layers, architecture variants, and compositions.

indexes.name: Mechanism Index
indexes.scope: Methods, mechanisms, state transitions, and operational algorithms.

indexes.name: Language Index
indexes.scope: Languages and DSLs; distinct from AST, IR, compiler, binder, kernel, and runtime.

indexes.name: Representation Index
indexes.scope: AST, IR, V-IR, manifests, and structural representations.

indexes.name: Execution Index
indexes.scope: VX, kernel, runtime, bindings, workers, jobs, and contracts.

indexes.name: Intelligence Index
indexes.scope: XV, minds, routing, composition, arbitration, and intelligence allocation.

indexes.name: Knowledge Index
indexes.scope: LNS, memory, patterns, entities, causal and temporal knowledge.

indexes.name: Governance Index
indexes.scope: Constitution, authority, policy, capability controls, and admission.

indexes.name: Verification Index
indexes.scope: VV, conformance, replay checks, and verifier outcomes.

indexes.name: Proof Index
indexes.scope: Evidence, proof obligations, proof results, and attestations.

indexes.name: Generation Index
indexes.scope: ASGF, generators, Forge, synthesis, and candidate generation.

indexes.name: Genome Index
indexes.scope: System Genome, Architecture Genome, and Capability Genome.

indexes.name: Simulation Index
indexes.scope: Digital Twin, counterfactuals, simulations, and experiments.

indexes.name: Evolution Index
indexes.scope: AEF, SER Ω, GROT, mutation, selection, and promotion.

indexes.name: Operational Index
indexes.scope: OIF, health, readiness, recovery, observability, and operations.

indexes.name: Project Index
indexes.scope: Project identity and owners.

indexes.name: Repository Index
indexes.scope: Repositories remain distinct from projects, systems, and components.

indexes.name: File Index
indexes.scope: Source files, content digests, and generated artifacts.

indexes.name: Visual Index
indexes.scope: Diagrams and visual representations.

indexes.name: Lineage Index
indexes.scope: Origin, derivation, revision, and supersession.

indexes.name: Idea Registry
indexes.scope: Ideas stay distinct from innovations and implementations.

indexes.name: Innovation Registry
indexes.scope: Innovation origins, prior art, dependencies, evidence, status, and canonical form.

indexes.name: Subsystem Registry
indexes.scope: Subsystem identity and parent-child relations.

indexes.name: Model Registry
indexes.scope: AI and solver models, capabilities, contracts, and limits.

indexes.name: Protocol Registry
indexes.scope: Protocols, interfaces, and compatibility.

indexes.name: Algorithm Registry
indexes.scope: Algorithm specifications and implementations.

indexes.name: Engine Registry
indexes.scope: Engines and provided capabilities.

indexes.name: Mind Registry
indexes.scope: Research, reasoning, planning, verification, and specialist minds.

indexes.name: Agent Registry
indexes.scope: Identity, owner, capabilities, tools, policy, memory, and audit boundaries.

indexes.name: Artifact Registry
indexes.scope: Specifications, builds, packages, reports, diagrams, and outputs.

indexes.name: Evidence Registry
indexes.scope: Source-backed evidence with provenance and validation.

indexes.name: Capability Registry
indexes.scope: Preconditions, I/O, authority, limits, dependencies, and proof obligations.

indexes.name: Authority Registry
indexes.scope: Permissions, approvals, and delegation ownership.

indexes.name: Pattern Registry
indexes.scope: Recovered and derived reusable patterns.

indexes.name: Version Registry
indexes.scope: Revisions, compatibility, and supersession history.

indexes.name: Contract Graph / Index
indexes.scope: Inputs, outputs, invariants, dependencies, and acceptance rules.

indexes.name: State Graph / Index
indexes.scope: States and legal transitions.

indexes.name: Semantic Graph / Index
indexes.scope: Meaning, aliases, and canonicalization relations.

indexes.name: Dependency Graph / Index
indexes.scope: Typed dependencies and impact propagation.

indexes.name: Causal Graph / Index
indexes.scope: Causal hypotheses and evidence.

indexes.name: Generation Graph
indexes.scope: Candidate origins, derivations, mutations, and composition.

indexes.name: Evolution Graph
indexes.scope: Evolution lineage, selection, and governed promotion.

indexes.name: Innovation Graph
indexes.scope: Innovation dependencies, composition, evidence, and lifecycle.

indexes.name: Authority Graph
indexes.scope: Decision and approval edges.

indexes.name: Evidence Graph
indexes.scope: Source → claim → test → proof links.

indexes.name: Proof Graph
indexes.scope: Proof obligations, verifiers, and proof artifacts.
